title: Uniform Care Delivery & Clinical Pathway Adherence
description: Ensures care is delivered in a uniform manner according to clinical pathways across all departments.
correctiveAction: Enforce clinical pathway adherence checklists in EHR and audit skipped steps in ICU and Surgery.

title: Emergency & ICU Response Time
description: Patient waiting and triage response time in Emergency and ICU admissions.
correctiveAction: Augment triage staff during peak evening hours and streamline initial registration workflow.

title: Healthcare-Associated Infection Control
description: Surveillance and reduction of hospital-acquired infections including CAUTI, CLABSI, and SSI.
indicator: Hospital Acquired Infection Rate (per 1000 bed days)
correctiveAction: Perform mandatory central line insertion bundle audits and increase antimicrobial stewardship rounds.

title: Adverse Incident & Medication Error Reporting
description: Active monitoring and root cause analysis of medication dispensing and clinical pathway deviations.
correctiveAction: Implement dual-nurse barcode scanning verification prior to medication administration.

title: Identify Patients Correctly
description: Use at least two patient identifiers before administering medications, blood, or diagnostic testing.
correctiveAction: Re-train nursing staff and introduce biometric/wristband scanning checkpoints.

title: Improve Effective Communication
description: Standardized handoff and critical laboratory results communication within defined timeframes.
correctiveAction: Integrate automated SMS/pager alerts from the laboratory LIS directly to attending physicians.

title: Staffing Adequacy and Workload Balance
description: Maintaining safe nurse-to-patient and doctor-to-patient staffing ratios in high-acuity wards.
correctiveAction: Deploy float pool nurses to high-occupancy shifts to restore 1:2 ICU staffing.

title: Door-to-Balloon time for STEMI patients <= 90 minutes
description: Door-to-Balloon time for STEMI patients <= 90 minutes
indicator: Door-to-Balloon time for STEMI patients <= 90 minutes
